ns2:section.sectionText: This is the international immersion trip to India over Winter Break that will involve field research in urban, semi-urban, and rural South India. You must complete an application process to register for this course: https://orgsync.com/70977/forms/108055 Students may not receive credit for this course and BADM 532 and/or BADM 533. Please contact Kelly O'Neill koneill2@illinois.edu or Nadine Gleason nlin2@illinois.edu if you are interested in this course.
